questions.question_english:
Consider the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A): The Constitution allows the President to declare a National Emergency, during which the enforcement of the Right to Education under Article 21A can be suspended by Presidential Order.
Reason (R): Article 359 allows the President to suspend the right to move any court for the enforcement of fundamental rights during an emergency, except Articles 20 and 21.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Article 359 allows Presidential suspension of court enforcement of fundamental rights during emergency, excluding Articles 20 and 21. Because Article 21A is an independent article inserted separately, its enforcement can be suspended under Article 359, making the reason a direct explanation of the assertion.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत की उत्तर-कुंजी के अनुसार सही उत्तर है: A और R दोनों सही हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या है। अनुच्छेद 359 आपातकाल के दौरान निर्दिष्ट मौलिक अधिकारों के प्रवर्तन के लिए न्यायालय जाने के अधिकार को राष्ट्रपति के आदेश द्वारा निलंबित करने से संबंधित है; अनुच्छेद 20 और 21 इसके अपवाद हैं। स्रोत की व्याख्या अनुच्छेद 21क को अलग से इन अपवादों में सूचीबद्ध न होने के आधार पर प्रश्न का निष्कर्ष निकालती है। यह संवैधानिक प्रश्न सूक्ष्म है और किसी वास्तविक आपातकालीन परिस्थिति में लागू राष्ट्रपति आदेश, अनुच्छेद 358/359 तथा न्यायिक व्याख्या का अलग से विश्लेषण आवश्यक होगा।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 359 allows Presidential suspension of court enforcement of fundamental rights during emergency, excluding Articles 20 and 21. Because Article 21A is an independent article inserted separately, its enforcement can be suspended under Article 359, making the reason a direct explanation of the assertion.

questions.question_english:
Consider these statements regarding the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act (EWS Reservation):
I. It amended Article 15 and Article 16.
II. It allowed up to 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections.
III. It applies to admissions in educational institutions, including private unaided institutions, except minority educational institutions. 
Which of the above statements are correct?
options_english: I and II
II and III
I and III
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: The 103rd Amendment Act, 2019 amended Articles 15 and 16 to enable up to 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections in educational institutions (public and private unaided), while explicitly exempting minority educational institutions under Article 30(1). Thus, all three statements are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर है: I, II और III। 103वें संविधान संशोधन, 2019 ने अनुच्छेद 15(6) और 16(6) जोड़े, जिससे आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों के लिए शिक्षा में प्रवेश और सार्वजनिक रोजगार में 10 प्रतिशत तक आरक्षण की अनुमति मिली। अनुच्छेद 15(6) सार्वजनिक और निजी, सहायता प्राप्त तथा गैर-सहायता प्राप्त शैक्षणिक संस्थानों तक लागू हो सकता है, लेकिन अनुच्छेद 30(1) के अल्पसंख्यक संस्थानों को अपवाद बनाया गया है। इसलिए तीनों कथन सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The 103rd Amendment Act, 2019 amended Articles 15 and 16 to enable up to 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections in educational institutions (public and private unaided), while explicitly exempting minority educational institutions under Article 30(1). Thus, all three statements are correct.

questions.question_english: What is the constitutional implication of placing 'Education' in the Concurrent List (Entry 25) for a school Principal in Delhi?
options_english: The Principal must strictly follow Central statutory rules while completely ignoring local state laws like the Delhi School Education Act.
Governed by both Union and GNCTD laws, with Union law prevailing during conflicts.
The Principal answers directly and exclusively to the administrative directives issued by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi.
The Principal possesses total administrative autonomy in curriculum design, functioning independently of statutory bodies like CBSE or DoE.
questions.explanation_english: Education's placement on the Concurrent List (Entry 25) subjects school administration in Delhi to both Central statutes (like RTE Act) and state legislation (like Delhi School Education Act). Under Article 254, state rules operate continuously alongside central regulations, but Parliamentary enactment prevails in case of repugnancy or conflict.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर B है। शिक्षा समवर्ती सूची में होने के कारण संसद और राज्य/केंद्रशासित प्रदेश की विधायिका, अपनी संवैधानिक शक्तियों की सीमा में, शिक्षा से संबंधित कानून बना सकती हैं। दिल्ली के विद्यालयों को RTE अधिनियम जैसे केंद्रीय कानूनों के साथ दिल्ली के लागू शिक्षा कानूनों का भी पालन करना पड़ सकता है। जहाँ दोनों कानूनों में वास्तविक असंगति हो, वहाँ अनुच्छेद 254 और दिल्ली पर लागू विशेष संवैधानिक प्रावधानों को देखना आवश्यक है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Governed by both Union and GNCTD laws, with Union law prevailing during conflicts.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Education's placement on the Concurrent List (Entry 25) subjects school administration in Delhi to both Central statutes (like RTE Act) and state legislation (like Delhi School Education Act). Under Article 254, state rules operate continuously alongside central regulations, but Parliamentary enactment prevails in case of repugnancy or conflict.

questions.question_english:
Consider these statements regarding the TMA Pai Foundation v. State of Karnataka (2002) judgment:
I. It held that the right to establish an educational institution is a fundamental right under Article 19(1)(g).
II. It ruled that minority institutions receiving state aid are entirely exempt from state regulations regarding academic standards.
III. It stated that unaided minority institutions have absolute autonomy in the admission of students.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
options_english: I only
I and III
II and III
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: In TMA Pai Foundation (2002), the Supreme Court affirmed that establishing educational institutions is a fundamental right under Article 19(1)(g) and recognized maximum autonomy for unaided minority institutions in student admissions. However, aided minority institutions remain subject to state regulations, including academic standards and non-discrimination mandates, making them non-exempt from overarching statutory rules governing state-aided educational facilities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर B है। टी.एम.ए. पाई फाउंडेशन निर्णय में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने शैक्षणिक संस्थान स्थापित करने के अधिकार को अनुच्छेद 19(1)(छ) से जोड़ा और गैर-सहायता प्राप्त अल्पसंख्यक संस्थानों को प्रवेश के मामले में पर्याप्त स्वायत्तता दी। लेकिन सहायता प्राप्त अल्पसंख्यक संस्थान शैक्षणिक मानकों और गैर-भेदभाव संबंधी वैध नियमों से पूरी तरह मुक्त नहीं हैं। इसलिए कथन II गलत है और कथन I तथा III सही माने गए हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In TMA Pai Foundation (2002), the Supreme Court affirmed that establishing educational institutions is a fundamental right under Article 19(1)(g) and recognized maximum autonomy for unaided minority institutions in student admissions. However, aided minority institutions remain subject to state regulations, including academic standards and non-discrimination mandates, making them non-exempt from overarching statutory rules governing state-aided educational facilities.

questions.question_english: Read the situation below and answer the question that follows: A group of teachers goes on an indefinite strike demanding better pay. The State Government enacts a law banning strikes by essential service workers, including teachers. The teachers challenge this claiming it violates their fundamental right to form associations and unions. What is the constitutional position?
options_english: The fundamental right to form associations under Article 19(1)(c) automatically encompasses the right to strike indefinitely.
Article 19(1)(c) does not include a right to strike; the State may restrict strikes in public interest.
Public school teachers are legally classified as public servants and therefore enjoy no fundamental rights under Article 19.
Statutory bans on strikes by educational workers directly violate the right to personal liberty under Article 21 of the Constitution.
questions.explanation_english: In TK Rangarajan v. Government of Tamil Nadu (2003), the Supreme Court ruled that the fundamental right to form associations under Article 19(1)(c) does not carry a fundamental right to strike. The State can legally prohibit strikes by public employees in the interest of public order.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Article 19(1)(c) does not include a right to strike; the State may restrict strikes in public interest.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In TK Rangarajan v. Government of Tamil Nadu (2003), the Supreme Court ruled that the fundamental right to form associations under Article 19(1)(c) does not carry a fundamental right to strike. questions.explanation_english: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form, while Article 46 directs the State to promote the educational interests of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes and protect them from social injustice and exploitation. Together, they form the constitutional basis for preventing discrimination in schools.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर अनुच्छेद 17 को अनुच्छेद 46 के साथ पढ़ना है। अनुच्छेद 17 अस्पृश्यता का उन्मूलन करता है और उसके किसी भी रूप में व्यवहार को निषिद्ध करता है। अनुच्छेद 46 विशेष रूप से अनुसूचित जातियों, अनुसूचित जनजातियों और अन्य कमजोर वर्गों के शैक्षिक तथा आर्थिक हितों को बढ़ावा देने का निर्देश देता है। विद्यालय में भेदभाव, अपमान या शोषण रोकने के लिए दोनों प्रावधान प्रासंगिक संवैधानिक आधार प्रदान करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Article 17 read with Article 46.
